```{multiverse default-m-1, inside = game}
data_st1 = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(branch(level,

                       "conversation" ~ !Live )) |> 
  group_by(across(branch(level,
                         "participant" ~ c(ThreadId, Id),
                         "conversation" ~ ThreadId))) |> 
  summarise(branch(level,
                   "participant" ~ across(Type:percent_by_author, unique),
                   "conversation" ~ across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique)))

parameters(game)
```

```{multiverse default-m-2, inside = game}
data_variables = data_st1 %>%  
  select(branch(dv_iv,

      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~

    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~
```

#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 5: PLOTS
#' 1. Helper functions

```{r}
# Scatterplot function <- DV-IV relationship
plot_scatter <- function(df, dv, iv) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[iv]], y = .data[[dv]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = iv, y = dv,
         title = "Relationship between the dependent and independent variable")
}

# distribution of the DV and the IV
plot_dist <- function(df, var, bw, ds) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_dotplot(binwidth = bw, dotsize = ds, method = "histodot", stackratio = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = var, y = NULL, title = paste("Distribution of", var))
}

# Parameter function, used when scaling the x and y axes dynamically
dot_params <- function(x, n_bins = 60, aspect = 2) { # aspect: panel width/height
  bw <- diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / n_bins # x axis is cut into 60 bins (so that the binwidth is dynamic, however, the number of bins is 60 either way, regardless of the scale)
  max_stack <- max(table(floor((x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / bw))) # the size of the tallest pile: 
  list(bw = bw, ds = min(1, 0.8 * n_bins / (max_stack * aspect))) # d of dot: bw * ds. the tallest pile: max_stack * ds * bw. height of panel: n_bins * bw / 2 (bc. of the assumed proportion of panel width / height). 
}

# dv-iv separation
split_dv_iv <- function(x) {
  if (str_starts(x, "percent")) {
    dv <- "percent_by_author"
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^percent_by_author_")
  } else {
    dv <- str_extract(x, "^[^_]+")
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^[^_]+_")
  }
  fix <- function(v) if_else(v == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", v)
  list(dv = fix(dv), iv = fix(iv))
}

# variable selection 
get_dv_iv <- function(data) {
  cols <- setdiff(names(data), c("ThreadId", "Id", "Type"))
  list(dv = cols[1], iv = cols[2]) # output = list, function removes all cols but dv and iv, and then selects them. alternative option, used in the multiverse chunk
}
```

#' 2. `multiverse` node - only the plotting code
```{multiverse default-m-6, inside = game}
parts <- get_dv_iv(data_variables)
plot_df <- data_filtered2 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(all_of(c(parts$dv, parts$iv)))

dp_dv <- dot_params(plot_df[[parts$dv]])
dp_iv <- dot_params(plot_df[[parts$iv]])

dv_iv_plot <- plot_scatter(plot_df, parts$dv, parts$iv)
dv_plot <- plot_dist(plot_df, parts$dv, dp_dv$bw, dp_dv$ds)
iv_plot <- plot_dist(plot_df, parts$iv, dp_iv$bw, dp_iv$ds)
```

#' NODE 6: STATISTICAL MODELS
#' Includes: Poisson regression, Linear regression, Beta regression

```{r}
n <- nrow(results_n5)

# Initialize result containers
lm_models    <- vector("list", n)
lm_summaries <- vector("list", n)

poisson_ms   <- vector("list", n)
poisson_sums <- vector("list", n)
poisson_notes <- rep(NA_character_, n)

beta_models   <- vector("list", n)
beta_summaries <- vector("list", n)
beta_notes <- rep(NA_character_, n)
```

#' Helper functions

```{r}
# Capture model warnings and errors
capture_fit <- function(expr) {
  warnings <- character()
  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      expr,
      warning = function(w) {
        warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  list(
    fit = fit,
    warnings = paste(unique(warnings), collapse = " | "),
    error = if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      conditionMessage(fit)
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )
}

# convert model summary to CSV cell 
summary_to_text <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(
    capture.output(print(summary(model))),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

# create one row for a model's results
make_record <- function(i, dv, iv, status,
                        model_summary = NA_character_,
                        warnings = NA_character_,
                        note = NA_character_) {
  data.frame(
    universe = i,
    dv = dv,
    iv = iv,
    status = status,
    summary = model_summary,
    warnings = warnings,
    note = note,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```


```{r}
lm_results <- list()
poisson_results <- list()
beta_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(n)) {

  x <- results_n5$dv_iv[[i]]

  # ============================================================
  # iv-dv declaration

  if (str_starts(x, "percent_by_author_")) {

    dv <- "percent_by_author"
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^percent_by_author_")

  } else {

    dv <- str_extract(x, "^[^_]+")
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^[^_]+_")

  }

  iv <- if_else(iv == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", iv)
  dv <- if_else(dv == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", dv)

  df <- results_n5$data_filtered2[[i]] %>%
    ungroup()

  # do all variables exist? 
  if (!all(c(dv, iv) %in% names(df))) {
    message(
      "Universe ", i,
      ": DV or IV not found. DV = ", dv,
      "; IV = ", iv
    )
    next
  }

  # parsing info printing
  message(
    "\nUniverse ", i,
    " | DV: ", dv,
    " | IV: ", iv
  )

  f <- reformulate(iv, response = dv)
  y <- df[[dv]]

  # ============================================================
  # LINEAR REGRESSION

  lm_result <- capture_fit(lm(f, data = df))

  # if error, then return error
  if (!is.na(lm_result$error)) {
    message("Linear regression error in Universe ", i, ": ", lm_result$error)
  
    lm_results[[i]] <- make_record(
      i, dv, iv, "error",
      warnings = lm_result$warnings,
      note = lm_result$error
    )
  
  } else {
    lm_models[[i]] <- lm_result$fit
    lm_summaries[[i]] <- summary(lm_result$fit)
  
    lm_results[[i]] <- make_record(
      i, dv, iv, "success",
      model_summary = summary_to_text(lm_result$fit),
      warnings = lm_result$warnings
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # POISSON REGRESSION: applicable to non-negative integer counts 

  y_obs <- y[!is.na(y)]

  is_count <- (
    is.numeric(y) &&
    length(y_obs) > 0 &&
    all(is.finite(y_obs)) &&
    all(y_obs >= 0) &&
    all(abs(y_obs - round(y_obs)) < 1e-8)
  )

  if (!is_count) {
    poisson_notes[i] <- paste0("Poisson regression not applicable: '", dv, "' is not a non-negative integer count.")

    # create row for model's results
    poisson_results[[i]] <- make_record(
      i, dv, iv, "not_applicable",
      note = poisson_notes[i])
    
  } else { # fitter function, poisson with log link function
    poisson_result <- capture_fit(glm(f, family = poisson(link = "log"), data = df))

  if (!is.na(poisson_result$error)) {

    poisson_notes[i] <- poisson_result$error

    # create one row for the results - here errors 
    poisson_results[[i]] <- make_record(
      i, dv, iv, "error",
      warnings = poisson_result$warnings,
      note = poisson_result$error
    )

  } else {

    poisson_ms[[i]] <- poisson_result$fit
    poisson_sums[[i]] <- summary(poisson_result$fit)

    poisson_results[[i]] <- make_record(
      i, dv, iv, "success",
      model_summary = summary_to_text(poisson_result$fit),
      warnings = poisson_result$warnings
    )
  }
}

  # ============================================================
  # BETA REGRESSION: requires 0 < y < 1 (proportional values)
  
    z <- df[[dv]]
    z_obs <- z[!is.na(z)]
    
    beta_applicable <- (
      is.numeric(z) &&
      length(z_obs) > 0 &&
      all(is.finite(z_obs)) &&
      all(z_obs >= 0 & z_obs <= 1)
    )
    
    if (!beta_applicable) {
      beta_notes[i] <- paste0(
        "Beta regression not applicable: '",
        dv, "' must contain numeric values between 0 and 1.")
      
      beta_results[[i]] <- make_record(
        i, dv, iv, "not_applicable",
        note = beta_notes[i]
      )
    } else {
  
      beta_result <- capture_fit(
        betareg::betareg(
          f,
          link = "logit",
          data = df,
          type = "ML"
        )
      )
    
    if (!is.na(beta_result$error)) {
    
        beta_notes[i] <- beta_result$error
    
        beta_results[[i]] <- make_record(
          i, dv, iv, "error",
          warnings = beta_result$warnings,
          note = beta_result$error
        )
    
      } else {
    
        beta_models[[i]] <- beta_result$fit
        beta_summaries[[i]] <- summary(beta_result$fit)
    
        beta_results[[i]] <- make_record(
          i, dv, iv, "success",
          model_summary = summary_to_text(beta_result$fit),
          warnings = beta_result$warnings)
      }
  }
}
```
